title: Why Was the First Mobile Phone a Brick?
description:
Why was the first phone you could carry, Motorola's, the size of a brick?
We build the 1973 prototype part by part in 3D, follow it to the street demo in New York, then stand the first phone you could buy beside the one in your hand.
Sources: Motorola Solutions, Guinness World Records (Nov 2026).
Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.
